subject: Re: Kickoff: soft-attribute semantics for recommender search
body:
Status + one risk.

Pipeline reproduction is done: tags lowercased, filtered to user-item-tags with ratings >= 4, 0.75/0.25 split with a third of train held out for validation, matching our open-source release. CAVs trained on the linear movie embeddings look sane; on the SoftAttributes test set we're within 1.5 points of the paper's ranking accuracy on the top-tag subset.

The risk: coverage. When we restrict training to top tags by unique tagged movies, tail attributes (roughly 40% of SoftAttributes vocabulary) have too few tagged items to fit a stable CAV. Yara is testing whether pooling near-synonym tags recovers them; if not, v1 ships with head attributes only.

Will have the full readout Thursday.

Katya
